acip: MOS PA DE LAS GZHAN PA'I CHOS KUN TU SPYOD PA RNAMS KYIS SNGAR BSHAD PA'I MOS PA'I SA BON G-YOGS PA STE BSGRIBS PA'I MOS PA LA'ANG,
wylie: mos pa de las gzhan pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa rnams kyis sngar bshad pa'i mos pa'i sa bon g-yogs pa ste bsgribs pa'i mos pa la'ang
english: And then there are hopes that beings have which are different from these other ones: these are hopes that are entertained by those who are trying to practice the Dharma, whose hopes are obscured, or wrapped in the seeds of the hopes mentioned so far.
